text: You wake up after a period of time to find things around you have changed. Describe the first few
minutes as you adjust to your surroundings.
OR
Write a description with the title, ‘The Tree’.
OR
Narrative Writing
Write a story which involves finding something which was previously believed to have been lost or
destroyed.
OR
Write a story with the title, ‘The Day Before’.
